title: Implement origin and routeClient (OSRM drive hours)
description:
js/origin.js getOrigin(): geolocation, else saved home (localStorage), else config.DEFAULT_HOME; saveHome(). js/routeClient.js getDriveHours(origin, hikes): one OSRM table request (sources=0, annotations=duration), seconds to hours, cached 7d keyed by origin rounded to 2 decimals.

Acceptance: Joffre Lakes from Vancouver is roughly 2.5 to 3.5 h; denied geolocation falls back silently; no API key in the repo.

From docs/plans/0001-hiker-web-app.md, sections "Components > origin", "Components > routeClient".

comments.author: Claude
comments.text: Done: Joffre from Vancouver 3.1 h. Order changed to saved home > geolocation > default (plan U-001). Set home to Kelowna recomputed Joffre to 5.5 h.
